args.title: Fix error message for malformed row during upload
args.body: Issue 4203 reports that every file uploaded results in the error: "Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header". The error occurs even though the input files are correctly formatted and open fine in a spreadsheet application. The problem seems to be associated with recent changes in data export tools, which may have altered the expected format. This pull request proposes an update to the error message in src/i18n/en.json for clarity and to better inform users about potential mismatches in data format.
